result.stdout:
voxa — headless commands for the Voxa voice pipeline (Core).

Usage:
  voxa transcribe <file.wav> [--model <name>] [--language <lang>]
      Speech-to-text a 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV via whisper.cpp (prints the transcript).

  voxa say "<text>" [--out <file.wav>] [--tts piper|kokoro] [--voice <name>]
      Text-to-speech to a WAV file (default voxa-say.wav, Piper voice).

  voxa models [list | purge (<id> | --all)] [--cache <dir>]
      Inspect or clear the SHA-256-pinned model cache.

  voxa check [<appsettings.json>]
      Validate a Voxa pipeline config (providers, models, credentials) without downloading.

Models download on first use into the shared cache (VOXA_MODEL_CACHE or the OS default).
